description.value: Deoro Coffee Lounge is a café and espresso bar in Lillooet serving specialty coffees, freshly baked pastries, and locally sourced wraps and sandwiches. The space doubles as a private event venue for meetings and small celebrations, with both indoor and outdoor seating. A gift shop corner featuring local products adds an extra reason to linger.

address.value: 651 Main Street, Lillooet, British Columbia, V0K 1V0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms an active café at 651 Main Street, Lillooet, BC with a broad menu of coffees, fresh food, and beverages plus an online ordering system indicating takeout capability. The contact page matches the OSM phone number exactly. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: OSM name 'D'eoro Coffee Lounge' includes an apostrophe not present in the website name 'Deoro Coffee Lounge'; possible OSM data entry inconsistency.

OSM community is tagged as 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but the contact page places the business in Lillooet, BC (V0K 1V0), which is in the Fraser Canyon / Sea-to-Sky region, not the Okanagan & Thompson region.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active café in Lillooet — a small town on common BC cycling corridors — offering food, coffee, and indoor/outdoor seating. A useful resupply stop for touring cyclists even without confirmed cycling-specific amenities.
